text.zh_CN:
铅笔是一次性的书写工具，可以放入现代研究台代替笔与墨。虽然用完后就不能继续使用，但制作简单，不需要墨水。
将两块木板竖直放在一块木炭上方，就能合成一支铅笔。进一步研究也许能找到更持久、更方便的书写工具。
text.en_US:
A pencil is a disposable writing tool for the modern research desk. It is simple to make and needs no ink, although it cannot be used once worn out.
Place two planks vertically above charcoal to craft one. Further research may reveal more convenient, longer-lasting writing tools.
